reviews.author: leanne kelly
reviews.text: Amazing job had to cut a tree over the power lines. They were professional, great clean up and affordable. Thank you Rusty and your awesome crew. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mike Heiman
reviews.text: My Dad recently had a number of pine trees removed from his property by Tripp's Tree Service. The team was hard working and professional. Rusty quoted a great price for the job and did everything he promised. All phases of the job - cutting, disposal and clean up - went great. I strongly recommend Tripp's Tree Service if you need trees removed from your property.

reviews.author: Roger Ringer
reviews.text: Tripp's Affordable Tree Service, did a outstanding job of removing . How to bring multi loads of dirt and use the bulldozer to level the ground out trees and clean up. They were on time; and profession in all matter. Thanks again Rusty. Adding another review, to combined with the one right here. Rusty and his crew had to do some Landscaping on the same property a few weeks ago outstanding job. He was always checking to make sure he was making the right decisions while asking me either by text or phone. I highly recommend them for all that he said he can do. Give him a call he's reasonable and honest

reviews.author: linda jarvis
reviews.text: Tripp's removed 10 trees on my property, they were on time, did some extra work, ground stumps and cleaned everything. All done for a reasonable price. Crew was hardworking and friendly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James White
reviews.text: This crew made light work of heavy project( at for myself). They removed dense overgrown areas in my yard without a sweat. I wish I had before photos but I don't want to remember what it looked like before because it 10 times better. Give them a call you won't use anybody but them.

reviews.author: Pat Morrow
reviews.text: Rusty and his crew are the perfect example of what great service should look like. They were respectful, hardworking, and always on time. We are making major repairs to our home which requires the removal of many massive trees to accommodate some of the changes needed. Rusty quoted us a remarkable and affordable price...beyond fair. Although I was anxious at the thought of what could go wrong, since the trees were very close to the house, they came down with no issue at all. It was amazing and terrifying to watch. Afterwards the crew ground the stumps and cleaned the debris. You cannot even tell that the 22 trees were ever there. Thank you Rusty and crew!

reviews.author: Richard Ackerley
reviews.text: For anyone thinking about getting a pesky tree out of the yard, just quit thinking about it and do it like we did. Rusty Tripp is the guy to get in touch with. Him and his crew have everything to get the job done right at surprisingly affordable rates. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Craig Beavers
reviews.text: Rusty and his crew did a great job! Got there two days earlier than expected and took down two huge trees in a very tight, tricky spot. Had the stumps ground down and cleaned up all in one day. Very affordable as promised.

reviews.author: Robin Tilson
reviews.text: Update: the morning after I posted this review I got a call from Tripps saying they were on the way to grind the stumps. I was tempted to say no but wanted the job done. They were in and out in less than an hour. I just wish they had been more responsive before I wrote a bad review. I contacted them to remove several stumps in my yard. They said they’d be out that afternoon to give an estimate. After several phone calls they came out a week later. We got the estimate and we’re told they’d do the work within the week. Again, several phone calls and 3 weeks later, nothing. Just based on phone conversations I’d say they have no scheduling system and show up if they feel like it. Would definitely NOT recommend.

reviews.author: Diane Holliday
reviews.text: Rusty and Mike just finished taking down a monster pine in the fenced back yard - terrific job by the whole crew. Highly skilled and very professional work - they will be back next week to grind the stump. We are very impressed and so glad to have contracted with Tripps!

reviews.author: Tami Howard
reviews.text: Very prompt response to come by and give us an estimate. Extremely reasonable quote. Included the removal of five trees and the stumps along with all the brush. Looks so good like they were never here..not even one cigarette butt or soda can left behind like some contractors. They even raked debris from our gravel driveway! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tiphney Eastwood
reviews.text: Tripps took great care of us! They took a couple trees down and cleared some dead limbs off of a few trees. They were sure to get anything that might be to close to our home and were sure to clean up all of the debris. Great guys.

reviews.author: Chase Owens
reviews.text: Never had work done but very unresponsible on the road. Passing a truck on a two lane 45 mph road will in a no passing zone. Not to mention all the trash blowing out the back of his truck. Shouldn’t drive like that. Especially when you are driving a grey ram with company logos all over it.

reviews.author: Jenni Villane
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about the quality work, outstanding pricing and overall experience with Tripp’s. We had 10 trees removed and the entire process was top notch. Thank you for the excellent work! A+++

reviews.author: Chad Grimes
reviews.text: Recently had Tripps remove 7 trees in my back yard. They did a great job and left our yard in great shape. The end result exceeded my expectations.

reviews.author: Jaco Casserly
reviews.text: They are my go to guys when the job is a little too big for me to handle. And the name says it all. Affordable it is. Very impressive to see them laying big trees exactly where they say they will and when they leave you cant tell they were ever there. Thanks guys for a job well done every time.

reviews.author: Chris kelly
reviews.text: Tommy did a great job painting a very high peak on our house. Fair pricing. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Don Schroeder
reviews.text: 45 minutes after I called Rusty and crew showed up. Work done 25 minutes later. Great job and incredible response!!

reviews.author: David Winstead
reviews.text: The Tripp team assessed and removed two bad trees in the same day. No nonsense, fast and affordable. Give these guys your business.

reviews.author: Stephen Bell
reviews.text: Tripp’s did a great job taking down my trees in my yard! And The price was affordable! Thanks Rusty Tripp

reviews.author: Karl Goldkamp
reviews.text: We can't say enough good about the work they have done for us. They were fast, took down a 30 year old oak tree between our houses in this neighborhood. That couldn't of been easy to navigate, They ground up the stump deeply, we got to keep the saw dust for mulch, Then cleaned up the side and front yard. Just tremendous service all.
